pkgmetadata.longdescription: ZoneMinder video surveillance. API v2 is served at /zm/api by exactly one of apiv2-cake (upstream's CakePHP 2 API, the default) or apiv2-php (zm-php-api, a CakePHP-free replacement answering the same requests). apiv3 adds www-misc/zm-api, the Rust API v3 meant to replace API v2 in the long run, as a service next to it. These three flags, and mqtt, exist from 1.38 on; 1.36 serves CakePHP only. www-misc/zoneminder/README.md in the overlay shows how to choose a series.

use.flag: Serve API v2 at /zm/api with upstream's CakePHP 2 API (default; exclusive with apiv2-php; 1.38 and later)

Serve API v2 at /zm/api with zm-php-api (https://github.com/nabbi/zm-php-api), a CakePHP-free API answering the same requests, layered over web/api in place of CakePHP (exclusive with apiv2-cake; 1.38 and later)

Also install www-misc/zm-api, the Rust API v3 at /zm/api/v3 that is meant to replace API v2, as a service on 127.0.0.1:8080 next to API v2, and enable the /zm/api/v3 proxy block in the web server examples (1.38 and later)
Enable using net-misc/curl for streaming from cameras

Build against dev-db/mariadb-connector-c and drive the database from Perl with dev-perl/DBD-MariaDB, instead of dev-db/mysql-connector-c with dev-perl/DBD-mysql (9999 and the 1.39 snapshots only: 1.38 has no DBD::MariaDB support). Either client library works with a MariaDB or MySQL server
Link dev-libs/libgcrypt for RTSP authentication (1.36 only; 1.38 and later do not use it, so the flag only adds the dependency)
Enable MQTT event publishing via app-misc/mosquitto (1.38 and later)
Use www-servers/apache as web server (and its user:group); exclusive with nginx
Use www-servers/nginx with fcgiwrap and spawn-fcgi as web server (and its user:group); exclusive with apache2
Enable using media-video/vlc for streaming from cameras
